headline: Shreeji Shipping Global approves 1-for-5 stock split
hook: Dividing each share into five pieces

modes.bear: A stock split is a purely cosmetic corporate action that does not change the underlying fundamental value of the company.
modes.bull: Splitting the stock increases liquidity and makes individual shares more affordable for small retail investors to trade.
modes.simple: The company is splitting each of its shares into five smaller ones. If you own 1 share worth Rs 10, you will now own 5 shares worth Rs 2 each. Your total wealth stays the same.

summary: Shreeji Shipping Global's board has approved the subdivision of one equity share with a face value of Rs 10 into five equity shares with a face value of Rs 2 each. The decision was finalized at the board meeting held on November 14, 2026. Stock splits increase the number of shares in circulation while proportionally reducing the share price, aiming to enhance liquidity. Retail investors holding the stock will see their share count multiply fivefold without changing their total investment value.
whats_next: Record date for the stock split to be announced
why_it_matters: Your share count multiplies fivefold at a proportionally lower price.

headline: Shreeji Shipping Global provides update on promoter offer for sale
hook: Promoters cut stake in Shreeji Shipping
summary: Shreeji Shipping Global Limited has submitted an update to the stock exchange regarding an offer for sale (OFS) by its promoters. The filing indicates movement in promoter shareholding through the OFS mechanism. Retail investors tracking promoter activity should review the pricing and subscription details of the share sale.
why_it_matters: Promoter share sales can alter stock liquidity and float.
